name: FB Dashboard | Orders Incremental to Supabase [DISABLED]

parameters.content:
## CONTROLLED RELEASE SAFETY
Inactive template with a closed code gate. The first approved run is limited to a rolling 7-day order window, 100 orders per page and 50 pages. Every Shopify and Supabase request retries up to three times. A one-second pause is applied between Shopify pages. The checkpoint advances only after every page has been written successfully. Never widen the window or page ceiling without a separate review.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: `query DashboardOrders($query: String!, $after: String) { orders(first: 100, after: $after, sortKey: UPDATED_AT, query: $query) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id legacyResourceId name createdAt processedAt updatedAt cancelledAt displayFinancialStatus displayFulfillmentStatus test tags currentSubtotalPriceSet { shopMoney { amount currencyCode } } currentTotalDiscountsSet { shopMoney { amount currencyCode } } currentTotalPriceSet { shopMoney { amount currencyCode } } currentTotalTaxSet { shopMoney { amount currencyCode } } totalRefundedSet { shopMoney { amount currencyCode } } customer { id legacyResourceId displayName numberOfOrders } billingAddress { countryCodeV2 } shippingAddress { countryCodeV2 } lineItems(first: 100) { nodes { id name title variantTitle sku quantity currentQuantity originalTotalSet { shopMoney { amount currencyCode } } discountedTotalSet { shopMoney { amount currencyCode } } variant { id legacyResourceId product { id legacyResourceId } } } } } } }`, variables: { query: `updated_at:>=${$json.start} updated_at:<=${$json.end}`, after: $json.after } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify($('Normalize Orders, Lines and Customers').item.json.orders.map(({ raw, tax_total, ...order }) => ({ ...order, taxes: tax_total }))) }}
={{ JSON.stringify($('Normalize Orders, Lines and Customers').item.json.lines.map(({ raw, ...line }) => line)) }}
={{ JSON.stringify($('Normalize Orders, Lines and Customers').item.json.customers.map(({ raw, email, ...customer }) => customer)) }}
